intro: Basketball and canoe racing are popular in the Marshall Islands.

chapters.title: Canoe racing
text: Traditional outrigger sailing canoe races are held in Majuro lagoon.

chapters.title: Olympics
text: The Marshall Islands has competed at the Olympics since 2008.

keyTerms.meaning: A canoe with a side float.

places.intro: Where the Marshall Islands' biggest sporting moments happen.
